text:
zoe_finance: AP routed invoice INV-2026-1204 from Meridian Cloud — no PO match, total $6,250 (metered usage $5,750 + support $500). Anyone own this vendor approval?

marc_procure: Checking PO ledger. Only PO-44112 exists for a one-off trial. That explicitly excludes pay-as-you-go usage. :mag_right:

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Invoice INV-2026-1204 uploaded by zoe_finance. Status -> routing_hold (missing PO).

felicia_ops: If this is runtime infra it should hit cost center 343-Infra. @ryan_prod do you approve Meridian Cloud spend?

ryan_prod: I do. I can approve a retro/internal PO but need the usage hour breakdown. @zoe_finance can you paste the vendor CSV totals?

zoe_finance: Vendor CSV (excerpt):
```
date,region,hours,rate,amount
2026-02-08,us-east,300,19.00,5700
2026-02-09,us-east,5,10.00,50
```

marc_procure: Procurement preference: vendor reissue with PO on header for audit. For this pay cycle we can issue PO-R-2026-642 and route to @ryan_prod.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Created PO PO-R-2026-642 and linked INV-2026-1204. Payment hold until approval.

ryan_prod: Approved PO-R-2026-642. Note: confirm the 5h at $10 line with vendor (possible misc charge).

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Approval recorded. Payment hold released. Invoice scheduled Net 7 from approval. Finance will post interim accrual reversal upon payment.

zoe_finance: I'll ask vendor to reissue with PO on header and confirm the misc 5h. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
